content:
Day I: Arrival in the fair city of Tokyo  
Thou shalt lodge in a ryokan near the shrine  
Thou shalt wander the neon lanes of Shibuya  
Thou shalt feast upon sushi and sake  

Day II: Pilgrimage to the ancient capital Kyoto  
Thou shalt visit the golden Kinkaku-ji  
Thou shalt stroll through the bamboo grove of Arashiyama  
Thou shalt partake in tea ceremony at a quiet house  

Day III: Journey to the sacred mount Fuji  
Thou shalt ascend the slopes with steadfast heart  
Thou shalt behold the sunrise from the summit  
Thou shalt descend to the lakeside town of Kawaguchiko  

Day IV: Return to Tokyo for farewell  
Thou shalt explore the markets of Akihabara  
Thou shalt offer thanks to the gods at Meiji Shrine  
Thou shalt depart with memories etched in soul
